claim: The live run waits, before each paid step, until the gateway's pace has passed since its last send, so the run
itself never meets MODEL_COOLDOWN. Every answer the gateway settles now records why it ended and how long it
was, without its text: finishReason, contentChars, reasoningChars, reasoningTokens and the validator's
{path, code} pairs, in the call's ledger row and in the live-proof receipt step. The receipt step carries the
settled tokens and micro-INR from the gateway, and --report prints them. Not proven live: no provider call.

signature: step 11 refused MODEL_COOLDOWN: step 10 settled in 0.7 s and live-proof.ts sent the next call at once, inside
the 1500 ms pace; storey steps 1 and 9 truncated at 2048, mapping steps 3 and 6 TEACHER_INVALID_PLAN, and

D1_pace: the gateway tells the caller that holds it when a call is dispatched (after the ledger's dispatch commits);
live-proof.ts stamps that with its clock and, before each paid step and before a key-move re-attempt, waits
paceMs from the last send (waitForPace); the receipt step records paceWaitMs

adapter: answerDiagnostics(choice, usage): finish_reason kept only as a token of [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}, else null;
contentChars = message.content length or 0; reasoningChars = length of message.reasoning_content (or
message.reasoning) or 0, never its text; reasoningTokens = usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens
validation: TrustedCall.validationIssues(output) is run by the gateway on the minimized output of an answer without a
semantic error; storeyValidationIssues and teacherValidationIssues give the validators' issues as {path, code};
issuePairs keeps at most 20, a path keeps schema keys and indices (any other segment becomes *), a code
outside [A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64} becomes unrecognized; a mapping plan issue names the answer's field by position,
never by column name; null issues mean the answer was not validated (truncated or invalid output)
D2_diagnostics.unmeasured: an adapter that measures nothing (control, replay) gives null fields, never 0

D3_storage.statement: ALTER TABLE usp_model_calls ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS diagnostics jsonb;
write: PgModelCallLedger.recordDiagnostics: UPDATE usp_model_calls SET diagnostics=$2 WHERE id=$1 AND
config_hash=$3 AND diagnostics IS NULL, in its own transaction after settle, outside the settlement hash;
the gateway swallows its failure, so a demo without the schema step still settles every call as before
